question: Why is immense material wealth insufficient compared to this Kaula knowledge?
premises: One might possess an ocean filled with jewels.
This comparison sets up the value of the teaching.
inference: Even possession of an ocean full of jewels is presented as incomparable to the value implied by the teaching.
uncertainties: The fused token ratnasaṃpūrṇamakretuṃ is difficult to parse precisely without wider context.
plain_english: Even if one had an accumulation like an ocean filled with jewels.
